summary: Procure Annotree annotation platform with EU data residency and 25 temporary contractor seats, SSO integration
request_description:
Request summary:
We need to procure Annotree (annotation platform) for short-term labeling work tied to the Vision Evals project. Request is for a 6-month contract with EU data residency (data stored in eu-west region) and 25 temporary contractor seats that support SCIM provisioning via SAML SSO (Okta).

Business justification:
- Speed up image/text labeling for Vision Evals prototype with a trusted UI and built-in QA workflows.
- Contractors must only access EU-hosted data to meet customer compliance constraints.
- SCIM + SAML will reduce onboarding overhead and ensure audits reflect Okta group membership.

Mandatory requirements:
- EU data residency (physically store and process data in eu-west / eu-central).
- SCIM provisioning and SAML 2.0 integration compatible with Okta.
- Audit logs retention configurable to 12 months.
- Ability to restrict export/downloads for contractor roles.
- Contractual DPA and SOC2/ISO27001 evidence or equivalent.
cost_estimate: £28,500 EUR equivalent (estimated): base platform fee €18,000 for 6 months + 25 contractor seats €4000 + onboarding and SSO setup €2,500 + contingency/taxes €4,000
approvals_needed: Legal: Contract review and DPA approval by Priya Desai
timeline_request: Target start date 2026-04-01; onboarding window 2 weeks; SSO/SCIM tested by 2026-04-15
vendor_contact: Annotree Sales - contact@annotree.ai; Account Exec: Milo Richter; Draft MSA link: https://annotree.ai/msas/draft-redwood-2026.pdf
vendor_security_artifacts: Requested: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 cert, pen-test summary, privacy policy, DPA template. Links stored in procurement Confluence page.
integration_requirements: Okta SAML 2.0 + SCIM 2.0 support required. We will provision contractor group 'vision-evals-contractors' with limited export permission. Annotree must accept Okta groups and honor group-to-role mapping.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Annotree deployed to eu-west region and verified via endpoint. 2) SAML login succeeds for test Okta user. 3) SCIM provisioning creates users and assigns contractor role. 4) Audit log entries visible for login and export events. 5) Legal signs DPA and MSA or acceptable redlines.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: Procurement engaged vendor for price breakdown; vendor confirmed EU-hosted option exists but uses partner data center in eu-west.
2026-03-11: Security sent initial vendor questionnaire; Annotree provided SOC2 report (redacted) and ISO statement; pending pen-test summary.
2026-03-12: Identity team validated Annotree supports SAML and SCIM; minor SCIM mapping mismatch for 'manager' attribute noted (workaround via group mapping).
2026-03-12: Legal requested DPA edits for data subject rights and subprocessors clause; annotated draft returned to vendor.
2026-03-13: Finance indicated approval contingent on quarterly billing instead of up-front 6-month invoice; vendor open to split payment.

Miguel Santos (Assignee) 2026-03-11: Acknowledged. I'll run the vendor questionnaire and loop in Identity and Security. ETA for vendor QA: 3 business days.
Jordan Park (Security) 2026-03-12: Need assurance that export controls can be disabled for contractor role. Also request proof of EU data center tenancy.
Priya Desai (Legal) 2026-03-12: DPA needs minor redlines — will attach markups to Confluence. Hold signing until redlines accepted.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Vendor's EU hosting is via partner DC which may introduce subprocessor complexity. Mitigation: require subprocessors list and contractual commitments in DPA.
Risk: SCIM attribute mismatch could slow onboarding. Mitigation: Identity to implement group mapping workaround; Annotree to add attribute in next minor release.
Risk: Contractors may be able to export data. Mitigation: enforce export restriction at role level and run test scenarios during acceptance.

Security to review pen-test summary when received (owner: Jordan Park)

Finance to confirm final invoice schedule and cost center tag (owner: Lena Weiss)
Schedule kickoff call with Annotree and Vision Evals PMs week of 2026-03-17
resolution: Pending approvals and vendor responses; no final resolution yet.
